alerts.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
alerts.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.

alerts.title: Fusion's Next Race Is Over Superconducting Tape, Not Plasma
alerts.summary: The race to build the world’s first commercial fusion power plant has moved out of the physics lab and onto the factory floor. Private investors poured a record $4.48 billion into fusion last year, a 69% jump, bringing the industry’s total since 2021 to $14.24 billion. According to the Fusion Industry Association, 71% of the 56 private fusion companies it surveyed expect to deliver power to the grid by the 2030s.  The front-runners already have buyers, with Washington-based Helion signing a power purchase agreement with Microsoft…
